name: Seikishi Celsia ~Akuratsutaru Himegimi~
original_name: 聖騎士セルシア ～悪辣たる姫君～
source:
Celsia, Aishu and Fiorun had toppled the demon overlord who threatened to conquer their world. Peace returned, but only briefly.

A messenger came to Forestoire, Celsia's homeland, to beg the heroines' assistance in a nearby village.
They embarked to help, and came face to face with Luquus, the daughter of the toppled demon.
She vowed revenge for what they'd done to her father......! 

A visual novel of epic depravity, where myriad creatures destroy the yielded loins of a holy knight and her party! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE164448.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
塞尔西亚、艾修和菲奥伦击败了企图征服世界的魔王。和平短暂恢复后，新的危机便随之而来。

一名使者来到塞尔西亚的故乡福雷斯托瓦，请求她们帮助附近的村庄。她们前去援助，却遇见了被击败魔王的女儿露库丝。

她发誓要为父亲遭遇的一切复仇……！

这是一部极度淫乱的视觉小说，描写无数生物摧残圣骑士及其同伴交出的下体！

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE164448.html]DLsite English[/url]]
